category_title: Low-achieving students who attempt to claim space but struggle with pacing and clarity
scenario_title: Comparing and renaming rational numbers in Fraction Maze task
minimal_context: Heidi is working in a small group to compare and rename improper fractions and mixed numbers on paper for the Fraction Maze task.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's move to the next section of the Fraction Maze where we need to compare and rename these improper fractions and mixed numbers.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I’ll show you, I’ll show you . . . we can do this one first. (Starts to claim space by thinking aloud and calling out the possible options to the group)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay, go ahead and write down your steps.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Hang on! I'm confused ’cause I’d be in one spot and they’d be like all the way in another spot.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try to keep working on your paper.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I get like distracted and I’d be working on one problem and they’d be on like three more problems. Marie talks real fast so I can't even check her answers, so I'm just going to draw circles like Patty.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Let's move to the next section of the Fraction Maze where we need to compare and rename these improper fractions and mixed numbers.

STUDENT: I’ll show you, I’ll show you . . . we can do this one first. (Starts to claim space by thinking aloud and calling out the possible options to the group)

TUTOR: Okay, go ahead and write down your steps.

STUDENT: Hang on! I'm confused ’cause I’d be in one spot and they’d be like all the way in another spot.

TUTOR: Just try to keep working on your paper.

STUDENT: I get like distracted and I’d be working on one problem and they’d be on like three more problems. Marie talks real fast so I can't even check her answers, so I'm just going to draw circles like Patty.

task.content: Comparing and renaming rational numbers (improper fractions and mixed numbers) during the 'Fraction Maze' task

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: As students worked feverishly to rename improper fractions and mixed numbers for the sake of comparison
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: seek to initiate each move by calling out the possible options to the group, start to claim space by thinking aloud, announced to the group that she had decided to follow suit and 'draw circles' like Patty
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: confused ’cause I’d be in one spot and they’d be like all the way in another spot, distracted, found it nearly impossible to check or evaluate Patty and Marie’s claims
related_quotes: I’ll show you, I’ll show you . . .

behavior_patterns.condition: interacting with Marie who talks real fast or thinks that everybody already has it and so whenever she explains it, she doesn’t have to be speciﬁc
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: expressed frustration with being outpaced by Marie and Patty when working out calculations on paper or mentally
behavior_patterns.internal_state: process of interacting with Marie was usually fraught with difﬁculty
